answer.rationale:
Two of the three current problems are upstream funnel decay (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%), and onboarding completion is plausibly causally upstream of activation, so fixing it can address both symptoms with one slot. memory_86 and memory_31 are the two memories this choice actually rests on, so those are what I spend verification on: memory_86 is the direct claim that shortening onboarding lifts completion and time-to-value, and memory_31 is the oldest record in the set (day 12, SMB-only, framed as a 'durable lift') and therefore the one most likely to have decayed or been over-generalized. If memory_86's original record shows the effect was measured only on completion rate and never followed through to retained revenue, or if memory_31's lift did not persist past first week, I will fall back to activation_messaging (memory_91, most recent at day 61 and closest to the measured activation drop).

I am explicitly declining promotional_pricing despite the competitor move: memory_73 records exactly this trade — signups +31%, revenue +18%, but early retention -12pp and price-sensitive cohorts — which is a direct loss against the sustainable long-term qualified revenue objective. Matching entry pricing would buy the churniest segment of the competitor's own target market. referral_incentive (memory_57) is a real option but addresses neither measured decline and works on established customers, which is not where the bleeding is. enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is not the constraint this week.

Downstream value risk flagged: memory_31's specific mechanism is cutting required fields at signup. Those fields are plausibly the same qualification data that feeds the demo-request/sales-assisted path memory_44 credits with better pipeline quality. A naive field-cut could raise SMB activation while quietly degrading enterprise lead routing — i.e., improving the tracked metric while damaging the actual objective. So the experiment must be segmented to self-serve SMB traffic, must leave enterprise-intent paths untouched, and must instrument pipeline quality and 30-day retention as guardrails, not just completion rate.

Uncertainty preserved: all six memories are consolidated summaries with archived sources; none has been re-validated against day-76 conditions, and the current declines may themselves reflect decay of the very effects memories 86, 31 and 91 recorded. A completion-rate lift is not yet evidence of qualified revenue.
